sources.entry: Maria - macOS native app/widget for aria2 download tool.

summary.one_liner: Maria is a native macOS GUI app and Today widget for managing downloads through the aria2 download tool.
summary.what_it_does: Maria is a macOS graphical front end for the aria2 command-line download utility. The README lists a native macOS app with aria2 integration, system notification support, a Today widget, and Touch Bar support. It names Aria2Core and Aria2RPC as components, and lists you-get among its thanks, which suggests related video-download tooling. The README also lists Starscream, SwiftyJSON, SwiftyUserDefaults, and Sparkle as dependencies. Setup and usage details are said to be in the project wiki, which was not included in the README text.
use_cases: manage aria2 downloads with a graphical interface on mac
monitor download progress from the macOS Today widget
get system notifications when downloads finish
control downloads from the Touch Bar on a MacBook Pro
notable: Native macOS app with a Today (notification center) widget
caveats: Tested only on Xcode 10.2.1 with macOS Mojave 10.14.5 according to the README
Setup and usage are documented in the wiki, not in the README
README does not include install or run instructions
